fact: In the 2025/2026 budget speech of 7 May 2025 the ICT Minister said the Ministry intends to submit the consolidated National ICT Policy to Cabinet for approval, and that N$16,988,000 is appropriated to develop and facilitate implementation of ICT policies and laws.
title: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology 2025/2026 Budget Speech
publisher: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology, Namibia
